title: Dispatch: implement Captain seat routing, handoff tooling, and regression matrix (attempt 1)
description:
Implement the repo-local half of eshyra-kusc. The design is fixed; implement it
exactly. Do not redesign, do not widen scope, do not touch anything outside this
worktree.

Read eshyra-kusc for objective, category model, and acceptance criteria.

=== VOCABULARY ===

Two durable seats: "Claude Captain" (id claude-captain) and "Codex Captain"
(id codex-captain). A seat is a durable organizational role; "main session" is
only a harness/runtime classification and one eligibility condition. Never emit
the strings "Claude-main" or "Codex-main".

Three layers compose at startup: charter (durable, user-local, personal) +
live repository authority (unchanged, everyone gets it) + advisory predecessor
handoff. Only the middle layer is authority.

=== FILES TO CREATE ===

1. scripts/seats/seatContext.mjs   (shared library, ESM, no dependencies)
2. scripts/seats/claude-captain-context.mjs  (Claude Code SessionStart hook)
3. scripts/seats/codex-captain-context.mjs   (Codex CLI SessionStart hook)
4. scripts/seats/seat-handoff.mjs            (handoff CLI)
5. scripts/seats/install-captain-seats.mjs   (user-local installer/verifier)
6. packages/core/test/captainSeats.test.ts   (regression matrix)
7. docs/agent-captain-seats.md               (concise operator doc)

FILES TO EDIT

8. .claude/settings.json  - register hook 3 lines below
9. package.json (root)    - two npm scripts
10. AGENTS.md             - one short neutral subsection (exact text below)

=== 1. scripts/seats/seatContext.mjs ===

Named exports:

  CAPTAIN_MODEL_PATTERN = /fable|opus/i

  SEATS = { claudeCaptain: 'claude-captain', codexCaptain: 'codex-captain' }

  readHookInput(raw) -> object | null
    JSON.parse a string; return null on any parse failure or when the result is
    not a non-null, non-array object. Never throw.

  classifyClaudeSession(input) -> { eligible: boolean, reason: string }
    Fail closed. Ineligible, with these exact reason strings, checked in order:
      'malformed-input'      input is null (per readHookInput)
      'subagent'             input.agent_id is truthy
      'resume'               input.source === 'resume'
      'no-model-identity'    typeof input.model !== 'string' || model is empty
      'unauthorized-model'   !CAPTAIN_MODEL_PATTERN.test(input.model)
    Otherwise { eligible: true, reason: 'authorized-main-session' }.

  classifyCodexSession(input, env) -> { eligible, reason }
    Fail closed. Ineligible, exact reasons, in order:
      'malformed-input'      input is null
      'dispatched-worker'    env.ESHYRA_SEAT_ROLE is a non-empty string other
                             than 'captain', OR env.ESHYRA_DISPATCH_CHILD is a
                             non-empty string
      'subagent'             input.agent_type is a non-empty string
      'wrong-event'          input.hook_event_name is present and !== 'SessionStart'
      'resume'               input.source === 'resume'
    Otherwise { eligible: true, reason: 'captain-profile-session' }.
    NOTE: Codex Captain occupancy is gated primarily by WHICH CONFIG LAYER
    registers this hook (a profile overlay the dispatch path never loads), so
    this function is defence in depth, not the only boundary. Say so in a
    comment. Do not add model-name, cwd-basename, branch-name, bead-title, or
    permission-mode tests: they are explicitly rejected as identity signals.

  resolveSeatRoots(cwd, env) -> { charterDir, stateDir, mode } | null
    If env.ESHYRA_SEAT_TEST_ROOT is a non-empty string:
      charterDir = <root>/charters, stateDir = <root>/state, mode = 'test'.
    Otherwise:
      charterDir depends on the seat, so return charterDir = null here and let
      resolveCharterPath compute it; stateDir is
        <git common dir>/eshyra-seats
      resolved by running `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` with cwd, then
      making it absolute. Return null if cwd is missing, is not a directory, or
      git fails. mode = 'repo'. Use node:child_process execFileSync with
      stdio pipe and a short timeout; never throw out of this function.

  resolveCharterPath(seatId, env) -> string
    test mode:  <ESHYRA_SEAT_TEST_ROOT>/charters/<seatId>.md
    claude-captain: <homedir>/.claude/seats/claude-captain.md
    codex-captain:  <homedir>/.codex/seats/codex-captain.md

  readCharter(seatId, env) -> string | null   (null when absent/unreadable/blank)

  readHandoff(seatId, cwd, env) -> { text, path, ageHours } | null
    Reads <stateDir>/<seatId>/handoff.md. null when roots unresolvable, file
    absent, unreadable, or blank. ageHours = (now - mtimeMs)/3600000, rounded
    to one decimal.

  RECONCILIATION_BLOCK  (exported constant string, used verbatim by both hooks)
    Must start with the line '### Reconcile before acting' and must state, in
    prose: that everything in the handoff is a lead and not a fact; that the
    occupant must re-derive current work from live state before acting; and it
    must name each of these check targets explicitly by these words - 'beads',
    'branch', 'worktree', 'Git ancestry', 'commits', 'pull request', 'dispatch
    registry', 'recorded PGID', 'process identity'. It must state that a
    handoff is never permission to kill a process, reset a branch, force-push,
    merge, or discard a commit without live verification.

  renderSeatContext({ seatId, seatTitle, harness, charter, handoff, occupant })
    -> string
    Emits, in this order, and omitting nothing:
      '<!-- eshyra-seat: <seatId> -->'
      '# <seatTitle> - standing seat'      (use an em dash, not a hyphen)
      charter text
      '## Occupant (runtime metadata, not seat identity)' followed by a bullet
        list: seat, harness, model, session, started (ISO 8601 from Date.now).
        Missing values render as 'unknown'. Add one line stating that occupant
        metadata never confers seat identity and that capability is not
        inherited from a predecessor.
      '## Predecessor handoff (advisory - not authority)'  (em dash)
        Either the handoff text plus a line 'Recorded <ageHours>h ago at
        <path>.', or exactly 'No handoff recorded for this seat.'
      RECONCILIATION_BLOCK

=== 2. scripts/seats/claude-captain-context.mjs ===

Executable ESM script, shebang '#!/usr/bin/env node'.
Reads all of stdin (fd 0) as utf8; on any read error exit 0 silently.
Guard process.stdout against EPIPE exactly as .claude/hooks/supervisor-context.mjs does.
input = readHookInput(raw); c = classifyClaudeSession(input).
If !c.eligible -> exit 0 with NO output.
charter = readCharter('claude-captain', process.env); if null -> exit 0 with NO
output (absent seat state degrades to ordinary repository behaviour).
Else write renderSeatContext(...) with seatTitle 'Claude Captain', harness
'Claude Code', occupant model/session from input.model / input.session_id, and
handoff = readHandoff('claude-captain', input.cwd ?? process.cwd(), process.env).
Never let a handoff read failure prevent charter emission.

=== 3. scripts/seats/codex-captain-context.mjs ===

Same shape, using classifyCodexSession(input, process.env), seat
'codex-captain', seatTitle 'Codex Captain', harness 'Codex CLI'.
Additional guard, applied only when ESHYRA_SEAT_TEST_ROOT is NOT set: the
session cwd must resolve to a checkout that looks like Eshyra - the directory
containing the git common dir must contain BOTH 'AGENTS.md' and
'.beads/metadata.json'. If not, exit 0 with no output (reason 'not-eshyra-repo').

=== 4. scripts/seats/seat-handoff.mjs ===

CLI: node scripts/seats/seat-handoff.mjs <command> <seat>
  path <seat>          print the resolved handoff path
  show <seat>          print current handoff text plus its age, or a notice
  write <seat>         read markdown from stdin and write it (mkdir -p first),
                       prefixed with a single line
                       '<!-- recorded <ISO> -->'; refuse empty stdin (exit 2)
  clear <seat>         delete the handoff file if present
Unknown seat or command -> usage on stderr, exit 2.
Seat ids accepted: claude-captain, codex-captain. Nothing else.

=== 5. scripts/seats/install-captain-seats.mjs ===

Idempotent installer for the USER-LOCAL Codex pieces only. It must never write
inside the repository and never overwrite a file without first copying it to
'<path>.bak.<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS>'.
  --check   report status of every managed path and exit 1 if any is missing or
            differs from what would be installed; write nothing
  (default) install/refresh
Managed paths (compute the repo root from this script's own location):
  ~/.codex/seats/codex-captain-context.sh   POSIX sh shim, mode 0755, which
      reads the hook payload on stdin, extracts .cwd with node, resolves the
      git common dir from it, and execs
      'node <repo>/scripts/seats/codex-captain-context.mjs' with the payload
      piped back in; it must exit 0 silently on every failure path. Keep this
      shim byte-stable: Codex hashes the hook COMMAND STRING for hook trust, so
      the config must invoke this fixed path and the shim absorbs all change.
  ~/.codex/eshyra-captain.config.toml       profile overlay registering
      [[hooks.SessionStart]] with matcher "" and one command hook invoking the
      shim above, statusMessage 'Loading Codex Captain seat'.
  ~/.local/bin/codex-captain                mode 0755 wrapper: refuses with a
      clear message and exit 1 when ESHYRA_SEAT_ROLE is set to anything other
      than 'captain'; otherwise
      'exec env ESHYRA_SEAT_ROLE=captain codex -p eshyra-captain \"$@\"'.
It must NOT create or modify the charters (~/.claude/seats/claude-captain.md,
~/.codex/seats/codex-captain.md); it only reports whether they exist.
It must NOT modify ~/.codex/config.toml or ~/.claude/settings.json.
Print every path it touched and the backup it made.

=== 6. packages/core/test/captainSeats.test.ts ===

Vitest. Follow the style of packages/core/test/beadLifecyclePolicy.test.ts
(a leading comment naming the bead and why the evidence is permanent).
Run the REAL scripts as child processes:
  execFileSync(process.execPath, [scriptPath], { input: JSON.stringify(payload),
    env: { ...process.env, ESHYRA_SEAT_TEST_ROOT: tmp, ...overrides },
    encoding: 'utf8' })
Build a temp root per suite with mkdtempSync containing charters/ and state/
fixtures. Delete ESHYRA_SEAT_ROLE and ESHYRA_DISPATCH_CHILD from the base env
so an ambient value cannot mask a case. Cover exactly these, one test each:

CLAUDE
  1  model 'claude-opus-5', source startup  -> emits '<!-- eshyra-seat: claude-captain -->'
  2  model 'Fable 5.1'                      -> emits it
  3  Opus and Fable payloads also make .claude/hooks/supervisor-context.mjs
     emit its overlay (run that script too; assert its output contains
     'You are the supervising agent')
  4  model 'claude-sonnet-5'  -> claude-captain script emits NOTHING, and
     supervisor-context.mjs emits NOTHING
  5  payload with agent_id set (any model) -> both scripts emit NOTHING
  6  malformed stdin ('{'), empty stdin, absent model, and model 'gpt-5.6-sol'
     -> both scripts emit NOTHING  (fail closed)

CODEX
  7  SessionStart payload, no worker markers -> emits '<!-- eshyra-seat: codex-captain -->'
  8  same payload with env ESHYRA_SEAT_ROLE=dispatched-worker and
     ESHYRA_DISPATCH_CHILD=eshyra-kusc.1 -> emits NOTHING; assert each marker
     alone is independently sufficient to suppress it
  9  the same dispatched-worker invocation produces no Claude supervisor policy:
     assert the codex script output never contains 'You are the supervising
     agent' in ANY of the codex cases, and that supervisor-context.mjs emits
     nothing for a Codex-shaped payload (model 'gpt-5.6-luna')
  10 payload carrying agent_type 'reviewer' -> emits NOTHING; also assert the
     installed profile template registers SessionStart ONLY (read the installer
     source and assert it contains no 'SubagentStart' registration)
  11 malformed stdin, empty stdin, and hook_event_name 'SubagentStart'
     -> emits NOTHING

HANDOFF
  12 with both charters and both handoffs present, the claude script output
     contains the claude handoff text and NOT the codex handoff text
  13 the codex script output contains the codex handoff text and NOT the claude
     handoff text
  14 with ESHYRA_SEAT_ROLE=dispatched-worker, neither handoff text appears in
     either script's output
  15 handoff file absent -> charter still emitted and output contains
     'No handoff recorded for this seat.'; handoff file present but empty ->
     same; charter absent -> NOTHING emitted at all (degrade, do not block)
  16 both scripts' output contains '### Reconcile before acting' and every one
     of the named check targets from RECONCILIATION_BLOCK

WIRING
  17 .claude/settings.json registers scripts/seats/claude-captain-context.mjs in
     SessionStart and lists it BEFORE .claude/hooks/supervisor-context.mjs
  18 the privileged overlay text stays out of shared surfaces: assert
     AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md do not contain 'You are the supervising agent'
     and do not contain 'dispatch-codex.sh'

=== 7. docs/agent-captain-seats.md ===

Short and neutral. Cover: the two seats and that they are seats rather than
models; the three composed layers and which one is authority; exact storage
paths (charters user-local, handoffs at <git common dir>/eshyra-seats/<seat>/
handoff.md so every worktree of a clone resolves the same state, untracked and
never part of a clone or release); how to install, check, and roll back the
user-local Codex pieces; how to record a handoff; and an explicit statement
that seat state is never repository authority and that its absence degrades to
ordinary repository behaviour. Do NOT restate any privileged supervisor
workflow, and do not describe dispatch mechanics beyond the bare fact that
dispatched Codex workers are marked with ESHYRA_SEAT_ROLE=dispatched-worker and
receive no Captain identity.

=== 8. .claude/settings.json ===

Add to the existing SessionStart hooks array, positioned AFTER 'bd prime' and
BEFORE the supervisor-context.mjs entry:
  { "type": "command",
    "command": "node \"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/seats/claude-captain-context.mjs\"" }
Change nothing else in that file.

=== 9. package.json ===

Add exactly:
  "seat:handoff": "node scripts/seats/seat-handoff.mjs",
  "seat:install": "node scripts/seats/install-captain-seats.mjs"

=== 10. AGENTS.md ===

Add a new '## Agent Captain Seats' section immediately BEFORE '## Non-Interactive
Shell'. Keep it to a short paragraph plus a bullet list. It must say: Claude
Captain and Codex Captain are durable seats occupied by disposable model
sessions; seat charters and handoffs are personal, untracked, and never
repository authority; repository authority always outranks any seat charter or
predecessor handoff; a handoff is advisory and every claim in one must be
reconciled against live beads/Git/PR/process state before acting; and it points
at docs/agent-captain-seats.md. It must NOT contain any supervisor-only policy,
must not mention dispatch-codex.sh, and must not describe worktree ownership or
integration duties.

=== CONSTRAINTS ===

- Node 24, ESM, zero new dependencies. All five scripts must run standalone
  with `node <path>` and must never throw on malformed input.
- Every gate is fail-closed: absent, unknown, or unparseable identity emits
  nothing. Never emit text that asks a reader to ignore it - a prose disclaimer
  is not a gate.
- Do not weaken, reword, or re-gate .claude/hooks/supervisor-context.mjs or
  .claude/hooks/codex-subagent-workflow.md. Read them; leave them alone.
- Do not copy any content of .claude/hooks/codex-subagent-workflow.md into any
  file you create, and do not put it in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs, or bead
  text.
- Nothing you write may read, write, or require ~/.claude/dispatch-codex.sh.
- Biome is the formatter; run the repo's verification which formats for you.

=== DONE MEANS ===

`npm run verify:worktree` passes from this worktree with the new tests green,
and `node scripts/seats/install-captain-seats.mjs --check` runs without
throwing (a non-zero 'not installed' exit is expected and fine).
